votes.motion: Commissioner Wendel moved to approve the minutes from the November 12, 2024 meeting

Commissioner Wendel moved to approve both File # 2S24- SUB- 000442- 2024 ( a Preliminary Subdivision Creating Apex Plaza 13 Planning Commission Minutes Condominiums) and File # 32C24- CUP- 000437- 2024 ( a Preliminary Non -Administrative Conditional Use and Site Plan Approval to Construct a Mixed -Use Building) at 4255 South Redwood Road in Taylorsville, Utah subject to the findings and conditions outlined in the staff report
